title: Flexova package manifest (META-INF/flexova.json)
description: Normative structure of the Flexova manifest. Reference implementations check these rules by hand and report MAN_* codes (spec/errors.json). Unknown top-level members and unknown token groups must be ignored, for forward compatibility.

flexova.description: Format version as MAJOR.MINOR. Readers reject other major versions (MAN_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION).

level.description: Protection level (ADR-0004). Core Flexova supports only L0; L1 (Sealed) and L2 (Controlled) need extensions (MAN_UNSUPPORTED_LEVEL).

entries.description: Every archive entry except 'mimetype', 'META-INF/flexova.json' and 'META-INF/flexova.sig.jws', each listed exactly once.

tokens.description: Design tokens. Viewers compile them to CSS themselves; documents can never supply raw CSS.

color.description: Named colors, each with a light and a dark value. fg, accent and muted must reach 4.5:1 contrast against bg in both themes (MAN_LOW_CONTRAST).

font.description: Generic font stacks only, so no font files or names can be injected.
